kurz: A few drops of lemon or vinegar right at the end make a dish taste fresher and more vivid.
bild_im_kopf: Like switching on the light in a dark room.
was_passiert: Acid balances fat, sweetness and heaviness. It makes other aromas easier to perceive, much like salt. Added at the end, it stays fresh.
schritte: Add a few drops of lemon, vinegar or wine.
Only then decide whether it still needs salt.
